name: Sea-Changers Main Grants
summary: Small one-off grants for UK marine conservation projects run by charities and other organisations, with a community and grassroots focus. Two rounds a year.
reporting: An evaluation when the project is complete, covering measurable and non-measurable outcomes.

calls.label: Twice-yearly rounds
calls.recurring: Deadlines on 31 March and 30 September each year.

status.quote: Main Grants For grants between £500 and £2,500. Two grant rounds per year.

recurring.quote: Deadlines for the Main Grant programme are 31st March and 30th September each year.

applicant_types.quote: Sea-Changers gives one-off grants (i.e. not continual funding) to UK-based charities and other organisations (including schools) carrying out marine conservation related activities.

geography.quote: We fund projects across the UK and the British Isles - including the Channel Islands and the Isle of Man, for example.

window.quote: Deadlines for the Main Grant programme are 31st March and 30th September each year.

amount.quote: Main Grants For grants between £500 and £2,500. Two grant rounds per year.

access.quote: Complete and return the application form to info@sea-changers.org.uk.

reporting.quote: We ask all successful applicants to complete an evaluation when their project is complete.
